home.title: Your league. In your pocket.
home.description: Everything in one app for amateur and community sports: live scoring, rosters, standings and player careers.
home.heroSubtitle: Manage competitions, teams, and matches in one place. Fans follow live scores and players build their careers.

features.scorekeeperDesc: Referees and operators control the match from a phone with a 6-digit PIN: timer, goals, cards, and undo.
features.rostersDesc: Master and competition rosters with first/last name, jersey number and captain. Bulk import from clipboard.
features.standingsDesc: Automatic points and standings recalculation after every event. Real-time match timeline for spectators.
features.passportDesc: Personal profile with matches played, goals, and cards across every competition.
